name: Mysteries of the House: The Creator - Epilogue
source:
The House is always seen as a prestigious place, as it is governed by the one and only Caelus, the Creator — the god of this world. Those handpicked creations of his, called "House residents", are always considered by many to be lucky to be among the few who can live and be with him. As you, the external visitor — the catalyst — decide to change the fate of the residents, Caelus cannot help but entertain himself by watching how you could possibly change the world he has created. How far will your influence reach?

[From [url=https://spark180.itch.io/the-creator-epilogue]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这座房子一直被视为一个享有声望的地方，因为它由独一无二的造物主凯鲁斯（Caelus）——这个世界的神——统治。他精心挑选的那些被称为“房屋居民”的作品，总是被许多人认为是幸运的，能够成为少数能够与他一起生活和在一起的人。当你，这位外部访客——催化剂——决定改变居民的命运时，凯勒斯忍不住通过观察你如何改变他创造的世界来娱乐自己。你的影响力能达到多远？

[来自[url=https://spark180.itch.io/the-creator-epilogue]itch.io[/url]]
